Guru Prasad Yadav And Others vs State Of U.P. And Another on
11 December, 2024
High Court Of Judicature At Allahabad, Lucknow Bench

Case :- Application U/S 482 No. - 6587 of 2016

entities.text: High Court Of Judicature At Allahabad, Lucknow Bench
entities.label: COURT

sentences.text:
Opposite Party :- State of U.P. and Another
Counsel for Applicant :- Ghulam Mohammad Kamil
Counsel for Opposite Party :- Govt. Advocate,Vikram Jeet Singh Rathore
Hon'ble Om Prakash Shukla,J.
1. Heard learned Counsel for the applicants and learned Additional Government Advocate for the
State and perused the record.
2.

By means of this application under Section 482 Cr.P.C., the applicants, Guru Prasad Yadav,
Amarnath alias Janki Yadav, Teerath Yadav, Chandrabhan Yadav alias Chandu, Shivnath Yadav and Munawwar Ali, have prayed for quashing of the charge-sheet No. 81 of 2014 dated 08.08.2014 in Case Crime No. 2910 of 2013, under Sections 420 I.P.C., Police Station- Kotwali Nagar, District - Bahraich as well as summoning order dated 31.05..2016 passed by Chief Judicial Magistrate,
Bahraich in Case No. 3252 of 2016 arising out of Case Crime No. 2910 of 2013, under Sections 420 I.P.C., Police Station- Kotwali Nagar, District - Bahraich.

3. Learned Counsel for the applicants has submitted that the applicants have been falsely implicated in the aforesaid case as they have not committed any offence as alleged in Case Crime No. 2910 of Guru Prasad Yadav And Others vs State Of U.P. And Another on 11 December, 2024 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/113586987/
1 2013.

entities.text: Case Crime No. 2910 of Guru Prasad Yadav And Others vs State Of U.P. And Another
entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text: 4. Learned AGA has submitted that this petition under Section 482 Cr.P.C. is not maintainable as the applicant has got efficacious remedy by filing discharge application.
5. While entertaining this application, a Co-ordinate Bench of this Court, vide order dated 20.10.2016 has granted interim protection.

6. Taking into consideration the fact that the applicants are having an equally efficacious remedy to file discharge application before the competent Court, without entering into the merits of the issue,
the applicants are permitted to file a discharge application before the trial Court through counsel taking all pleas and grounds, which are available to them, enclosing therewith the relevant documents/evidence, which are necessary for disposal of the discharge application, within a period of three weeks from today and if such application is filed by the applicants before the trial Court within the aforesaid stipulated time, the trial Court shall consider and decide the said application strictly in accordance with law, by speaking and reasoned order and by affording an opportunity of hearing to the concerned parties, expeditiously, say within a period of two weeks thereafter.
7. The application is, accordingly, disposed of.
